method: the new publisher.build_series run in-process over the rewritten gold for each of the 939 published Cottonwood accounts, compared with the series object published now (no S3 write)
words: Counts only, no account id. All 939 series differ because the new publisher adds history_scope_basis and history_scope_claim. 102 series flip PARTIAL_HISTORY to FULL (their Returns-from sentence on the Performance tab goes), none flips the other way. 826 series gain a newer day. 657 series have a changed total_return_daily on a day both versions hold (the restated October days). INFERRED: the figures move again if a landing adds a day before the apply.
